articles.title: Company Overview
articles.markdown:
# Company

**Atlas Fleet** provides GPS telematics and driver coaching for commercial fleets. Support covers device install, data plans, and portal permissions.

articles.title: Data Plan Policy
articles.markdown:
# Data plans

Trackers include a pooled data plan. Overage triggers a soft cap notice then a 2GB uplift pack. Devices offline >14 days should run connectivity triage before hardware replacement.

articles.title: Hardware Replacement
articles.markdown:
# Hardware

In-warranty trackers with confirmed GPS failure are replaced after remote diagnostics. Out-of-warranty units get a 20% refurbished replacement coupon.
